items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days but does not establish complete TLS posture. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix only; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Handoff: continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness.
